preconditions.description: The number of books n and the length of each book title m must satisfy the given constraints.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == m for s in titles)
preconditions.description: Each book title must have exactly m characters.
All book titles must be pairwise distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers representing the sorted indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in output)
postconditions.description: Each index in the output must be within the valid range of book indices.

postconditions.expression: sorted([titles[i-1] for i in output], key=lambda s: [(ord(c) if i % 2 else -ord(c)) for i, c in enumerate(s)]) == [titles[i-1] for i in output]
postconditions.description: The output indices must correspond to the book titles sorted in asc-desc-ending order.
